name: Methodical critique
pitch: Find and summarise methodological critiques of a given academic paper.
instructions: Search for critiques of the paper. Use web_search with the paper title and the word 'critique'. When results appear, open the most promising links with browser_navigate. Read the pages with browser_snapshot and extract any discussion of methods, limitations, or reproducibility issues. If a page has nothing relevant, close it and try the next link. Summarise the main points in your own words. Do not invent citations or claim a source says something it does not. When no more useful pages are found, stop. Write a short summary (up to 200 words) of the methodological critiques you have found. If you cannot find any, say so plainly. Save the summary to a file with make_page and show it to the person.

examples.ask: summarise critiques of that paper on climate models
examples.does: search the web for climate-model paper critiques, read the results and write a short summary

readme:
# methodical critique
Finds and summarises methodological critiques of a given academic paper.
Needs web_search, browser_navigate, browser_snapshot, file_write, make_page.
Will not claim a source says something it does not.
